newsitem.title: CHINA: China said needing 1.0 mln T diesel fuel near-term.
newsitem.headline: China said needing 1.0 mln T diesel fuel near-term.

text.p: Chinese oil industry officials said on Tuesday China needed to import about 1.0 million tonnes of diesel fuel over the next month to ease a domestic shortage.
Officials of China National Petrochemical Co (Sinopec) also told Reuters they were seeking a waiver of duties on diesel imports.
The State Planning Commission decided to give half of its total diesel import quotas to Sinopec for the time being to ensure sufficient supplies, a Sinopec official said.

China imported 4.06 million tonnes of light diesel in the first 11 months of this year, down 25.3 percent from the same period in 1995, and 18,018 tonnes of heavy diesel fuel, down 86.6 percent, customs figures showed.
Officials said the domestic retail price for diesel was about 3,000 yuan per tonne compared with import prices of 2,700 to 2,800 yuan per tonne. ($1 = 8.3 yuan)
